title: An etale ring map realizes a prescribed finite separable residue field extension at a prime
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $\mathfrak p\subset R$ a prime ideal with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=R_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and let $L$ be a field extension of $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-pc-field-extension], with structure map $\iota:\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to L$, which is finite ($\dim_{\kappa(\mathfrak p)}L<\infty$) and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then there are a homomorphism of commutative rings $\psi:R\to R'$ such that the induced morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\psi:\operatorname{Spec}R'\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] (equivalently, $\psi$ is an etale ring map in the sense of Stacks, Algebra, Definition 00U1 [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-iff-etale-affine]), a prime ideal $\mathfrak p'\subset R'$ with $\psi^{-1}(\mathfrak p')=\mathfrak p$, and a field isomorphism $\lambda:\kappa(\mathfrak p')\to L$ such that $\lambda\circ\kappa(\psi)=\iota$, where $\kappa(\psi):\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa(\mathfrak p')$ is the field homomorphism induced by $\psi$ ($r/t\bmod\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}\mapsto\psi(r)/\psi(t)\bmod\mathfrak p'R'_{\mathfrak p'}$).

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00UD (algebra-lemma-make-etale-map-prescribed-residue-field, line 39810), proof lines 39819-39845 (primitive element, lift of the minimal polynomial after scaling by c not in p, standard etale algebra R[x,1/f']/(f) of Definition 00UB, Lemma 00UC(1))

proof.text: By the finite separable primitive-element theorem [lem-weil-pbc-finite-separable-extension-primitive-element], choose $\alpha\in L$ with $L=\kappa(\mathfrak p)(\alpha)$, and let $\overline f$ be its monic minimal polynomial. The minimal polynomial is separable by [def-pc-separable-polynomial], so it is coprime to $\overline f'$; evaluating a Bezout identity at the root $\alpha$ shows that $\overline f'(\alpha)$ is a unit in the field $L$.

Apply the denominator-clearing lift [lem-weil-pbc-etale-residue-polynomial-lift] to $R$, $\mathfrak p$, $L$, and $\alpha$. It gives $c\notin\mathfrak p$ and a monic $f\in R[T]$ whose reduction is the minimal polynomial of the image of $c\alpha$ over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$; replacing $\alpha$ by $c\alpha$ preserves $L=\kappa(\mathfrak p)(\alpha)$ and the preceding derivative condition.

Set $A=R[T,1/f']/(f)$. The standard-etale node [lem-weil-pbc-standard-etale-monic-derivative] makes $A$ etale over $R$. Sending $T$ to $\alpha$ and $1/f'$ to the inverse of $f'(\alpha)$ defines an $R$-algebra map $\theta:A\to L$.

Let $\mathfrak p'=\ker(\theta)$. Since $L$ is a field, $\mathfrak p'$ is prime. Put $C=A\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$; reducing modulo $\mathfrak p$ identifies $C$ with $\kappa(\mathfrak p)[T,1/\overline f']/ (\overline f)$, and evaluation at $\alpha$ identifies this ring with $L$ because $\overline f$ is the minimal polynomial and $\overline f'(\alpha)$ is a unit. Let $\mathfrak Q$ be the kernel of this evaluation map. By [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-ring-primes-residue-fields], $\mathfrak Q$ corresponds to $\mathfrak p'$: its contraction to $R$ is $\mathfrak p$ and the fibre-ring kernel is the prescribed prime. By [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-ring-residue-field-iso], $\kappa(\mathfrak Q)\cong\kappa(\mathfrak p')$; the evaluation isomorphism $C/\mathfrak Q\cong L$ therefore identifies $\kappa(\mathfrak p')$ with $L$, compatibly with $\iota$ (the compatibility on the base field follows from the tensor-factor map). Taking $R'=A$ and $\psi:R\to A$ gives the claim.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_residueField_equiv
    (L : Type v) [Field L] [Algebra p.ResidueField L] [FiniteDimensional p.ResidueField L]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable p.ResidueField L] :
    ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : Algebra A A') (_ : Algebra.Etale A A')
      (P : Ideal A') (_ : P.IsPrime) (hP : p = P.comap (algebraMap A A')),
      ∃ e : P.ResidueField ≃+* L,
        ∀ x, e (Ideal.ResidueField.map p P (algebraMap A A') hP x) =
          algebraMap p.ResidueField L x
lean.note: Exact existing statement: ambient A, CommRing A, p and p.IsPrime are section variables. Use iota.toAlgebra for the specified extension. Algebra.Etale agrees with affine Etale by the recorded dependency; pointwise compatibility is equality of ring homomorphisms. Independent universes u and v. Sorry map records s=false, ts=false.
